verses.english: This was said by the Buddha, the Perfected One: that is what I heard.

verses.pali: Sukhassetaṁ, bhikkhave, adhivacanaṁ iṭṭhassa kantassa piyassa manāpassa yadidaṁ puññāni.
verses.english: For ‘good deeds’ is a term for happiness, for what is likable, desirable, and agreeable.

verses.pali: Abhijānāmi kho panāhaṁ, bhikkhave, dīgharattaṁ katānaṁ puññānaṁ iṭṭhaṁ kantaṁ piyaṁ manāpaṁ vipākaṁ paccanubhūtaṁ.
verses.english: I recall undergoing for a long time the likable, desirable, and agreeable results of good deeds performed over a long time.

verses.pali: Satta vassāni mettacittaṁ bhāvetvā satta saṁvaṭṭavivaṭṭakappe nayimaṁ lokaṁ punarāgamāsiṁ.
verses.english: Having developed a mind of love for seven years, for seven eons of the cosmos contracting and expanding I didn’t return to this world again.

verses.pali: Saṁvaṭṭamāne sudaṁ, bhikkhave, kappe ābhassarūpago homi;
verses.english: As the eon contracted I went to the realm of streaming radiance.
As it expanded I was reborn in an empty mansion of divinity.

verses.pali: Tatra sudaṁ, bhikkhave, brahmā homi mahābrahmā abhibhū anabhibhūto aññadatthudaso vasavattī.
verses.english: There I was the Divinity, the Great Divinity, the vanquisher, the unvanquished, the universal seer, the wielder of power.

verses.pali: Chattiṁsakkhattuṁ kho panāhaṁ, bhikkhave, sakko ahosiṁ devānamindo;
verses.english: I was Sakka, lord of gods, thirty-six times.

verses.pali: anekasatakkhattuṁ rājā ahosiṁ cakkavattī dhammiko dhammarājā cāturanto vijitāvī janapadatthāvariyappatto sattaratanasamannāgato.
verses.english: Many hundreds of times I was a king, a wheel-turning monarch, a just and principled king. My dominion extended to all four sides, I achieved stability in the country, and I possessed the seven treasures.

verses.pali: ‘kissa nu kho me idaṁ kammassa phalaṁ, kissa kammassa vipāko, yenāhaṁ etarahi evaṁmahiddhiko evaṁmahānubhāvo’ti?
verses.english: ‘Of what deed of mine is this the fruit and result, that I am now so mighty and powerful?’

verses.pali: ‘tiṇṇaṁ kho me idaṁ kammānaṁ phalaṁ, tiṇṇaṁ kammānaṁ vipāko, yenāhaṁ etarahi evaṁmahiddhiko evaṁmahānubhāvoti, seyyathidaṁ—
verses.english: ‘It is the fruit and result of three kinds of deeds:

verses.pali: Ayampi attho vutto bhagavatā, iti me sutanti.
verses.english: This too is a matter that was spoken by the Blessed One: that is what I heard.
